explication: OpenVINO GenAI is a cross-language library for running generative-model pipelines on OpenVINO Runtime. A typical user supplies a prepared model and prompt or media through a Python, C++, C, or Node.js API and receives generated text, images, video, embeddings, or speech. The graph preserves the README’s major scenarios and optimization capabilities. Several implementation links are dashed because their call sites were not shown; the sampled VLM and continuous-batching code supports only a subset of the relationships.
